entities.description: A tall, slender flagpole with a smooth, light-colored surface extends vertically, topped with a spherical finial that appears golden or brass in color. The pole is positioned against a clear, pale blue sky, with a partial view of a statue's arm at the bottom left corner.

A close-up, three-quarter view of a classical marble statue of a young man with curly hair, wearing a draped toga secured by a brooch on the right shoulder. The statue has a serene, neutral expression and is positioned in front of a blurred French flag with red, white, and blue vertical stripes.

clothing.details: draped over left shoulder, fastened with a circular brooch on the right shoulder, folds visible across the chest and waist

attributes.pose: standing, facing slightly to the right
attributes.condition: weathered, with some discoloration and surface texture visible
